track-width.$description: Inline size of the switch track (2x the md icon size; 40px at the default brand). The thumb slide distance is track-width minus track-height, derived in CSS.

track-height.$description: Block size of the switch track; also sets the thumb inset via calc in CSS.

off.$description: Track fill when the switch is off; hover uses color.surface.sunken-hover.

on.$description: Track fill when the switch is on.

on-hover.$description: Track fill when the switch is on and hovered or pressed.

thumb.$description: Thumb fill in the off state; the on state switches to color.text.on-accent so the thumb stays visible on the accent track.
